title: AWARE 2.0 Phase 5 R6 — security audit harness (bandit + npm audit + gitleaks + trivy)
deliverable: Security audit: Bandit, npm audit, gitleaks, container scan

checks.check_bandit: Python AST security linter on training/*.py. Skips-with-warn if bandit not on PATH.
checks.check_npm_audit: Node dependency CVE scanner (npm audit --json). Always runs (npm is a hard dep).
checks.check_gitleaks: git history secret scanner. Skips-with-warn if gitleaks not on PATH.
checks.check_trivy: filesystem + Dockerfile scanner on src/, training/, Dockerfiles. Skips-with-warn if trivy not on PATH. Does NOT scan built images (operator-action for 'trivy image aware:tag').

flags.--strict: Promote warnings to errors (exit 1 on any finding). For CI use.

verification.syntax_check: bash -n scripts/security-scan.sh → OK; bash -n scripts/bring-up-coordinator.sh → OK
verification.strict_exit_code: 1 on findings (verified with --tool bandit --strict; bandit has 6 findings on this host)
verification.graceful_degradation: yes (gitleaks + trivy skipped with 'not on PATH' warning)

real_findings_on_this_host.bandit: 1 low (B110:try_except_pass at training/run.py:104) + 5 medium (B615:huggingface_unsafe_download at training/run.py:279-280 — no revision= pinning on from_pretrained)

follow_up_slices: Fix the 1 bandit B110 (silent except: pass) at training/run.py:104
Fix the 5 bandit B615 findings (add revision= pinning to from_pretrained calls at training/run.py:279-280)
Resolve the 1 moderate npm audit finding (run 'npm audit' to see what)
Install gitleaks + trivy on operator host (brew install gitleaks trivy) so all 4 checks run
Tighten bandit config to fail on medium+ in --strict mode (currently warns on medium)
Add a separate script: scripts/trivy-image-scan.sh that scans the built coordinator + training images (operator-action, ~2hr)
